rationale: tv_iterative-claude-agentic: val_n=200, tv_lambda=0.0025, tv_iterations=1000, tv_lr=0.01, tv_decay=0.01, tv_optimizer=gd, tv_init=zeros, rationale=iter-13 INIT-scheme probe (the documented structural-ceiling mechanism). TV core is plateaued: iter-8 (1000it, lambda=2.5e-3) hr=0.36286 best, iter-12 (1200it) 0.36274 (saturated). Optimizer/lr/decay all peaked at GD lr=0.01/decay=0.01. Last major untested lever is tv_init. docs/findings.md warns FBP+smooth init can make TV learn ~zero gradient (hr=0). ONE knob: tv_init fbp->zeros at best config (lambda=2.5e-3, 1000it, gd, lr=0.01, decay=0.01). HYPOTHESIS: FBP init warm-starts GD near the data-consistent solution; zeros forces reconstruction from scratch in 1000 GD iters. If hr collapses toward 0, FBP warm-start is essential for TV-GD on 128-view sparse breast (the documented structural dependence); if hr matches ~0.3628, GD is init-agnostic at 1000 iters. Budget: ~950s at 1000 iters, <1200s wall.
